BO.why: Boston Common: the lawn, the stairs, the kicker by the pillared hall and the red-brick row

BA.why: the arena-shaped building with the chimneys, the Gaudi spires and the fountain around it

BE.why: the sunken plaza with the half-pipe fountain below the shop fronts (Berlin has shop text everywhere - it is the level)

AU.why: the beachfront park: the lawn with its kicker, the round pavilion and the sand

NO.why: the French Quarter by night from above: neon rooftops, the tram line and the balconies

ST.why: Skatopia: the winding dirt track, the burning pile and the half pipe barn (#1 shows the huge bowl)

SE.why: the lava arena with its torches and the pentagram ring - the Pro Skater hell stage

SE2.why: the Triangle island with the UFO and the helicopters (weak: the level is an island in an out-of-world brown plane / sea; every view has some of it)

SC.why: the school courtyard from above: the quarter pipes, stairs and lawns with the brick halls round it

PH.why: the fountain plaza with its ledges, stairs and trees, the towers behind

DJ.why: the cliff-side road run with the ramps and the Almost banner (weak: Downhill Jam is mostly rock)

LA.why: the freeway overpass over the plaza with its purple ledges and the yellow kicker
